questions.prompt: `bash argv.sh $f` became two arguments. Which pipeline step manufactured the second word?

options.a: tokenization of the line you typed — the space was always a separator
options.b: word splitting of the unquoted expansion RESULT, after $f was replaced

questions.prompt: The reflex rule this course drills from here on:

options.a: quote a variable only when you know it contains spaces
options.b: double-quote every expansion unless you can say exactly why not

questions.prompt: Which characters in pure DATA (say, a filename) can change what a command does?

options.a: only shell metacharacters you type yourself, like ; and |
options.b: a space, a newline, or a leading dash
options.c: none — data is inert once it's inside a variable
